snippet.title: A Study in Blue - Demo Release Trailer | Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
🕵️‍♂️ A Study in Blue - Demo out February 23rd!

Dive into our pixel art semi-open world narrative mystery set in Republica.

Solve criminal cases, make decisive moral choices, and uncover the truth behind Blue’s past.

🔎 Live during Steam Next Fest

Wishlist NOW on Steam 💙
